text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- Prime Minister Antonio Guterres told the paper that the inflation target for Economic and Monetary Union (EMU) is the most difficult to meet.
- Insurance group Bonanca is to invest 1.5 billion escudos to change the image of its branches.
- EDP-Electricidade de Portugal will be partially privatised at the end of the first quarter of 1997, Under Secretary for Finance Fernando Teixeira dos Santos told the paper.
- Banco Chemical Portugal is to change its name to Chemical Finance, the paper learned.
- The government's 1997 budget makes progress towards Economic and Monetary Union in 1999.
- Planning Minister Joao Cravinho has promised transport companies that diesel prices will not rise until December.
- The armed forces will recruit 28,000 fewer people in 1997 due to the spending cuts in the budget.
